final_claim: For three pairwise-independent real observations with one common atomless marginal law, the six labeled strict-order probabilities are exactly \((a,b,c,b,c,a)\) with \(0\le a,b,c\le1/4\) and \(a+b+c=1/2\), every such point is attainable, and the resulting maximum-rank and two-calibration-score rank envelopes are sharp.
limitations: Specific to three observations and one common atomless marginal.
